title: Sample manifest
description: Input to `pnpm gen:docs`. Declares the handful of facts that differ between one app built on this kit and the next, so the mechanical parts of ARCHITECTURE.md, AGENTS.md, README.md, docs/app-workflows.md and the infra runbooks are written once instead of retyped per app. It carries NO API description: routes, parameters and response shapes come from docs/api/openapi.json, which `pnpm contract:export` writes from the FastAPI routers. Lives at docs/exec-plans/sample.json.

schema_version.description: Manifest format version. The generator refuses a version it does not understand rather than emitting garbage, because the manifest and the generator can travel separately.

name.description: Display name. Must equal APP_NAME in apps/web/src/lib/app-config.ts — `pnpm gen:check` asserts it, because the branding check derives the FastAPI title from APP_NAME.

slug.description: URL- and storage-safe form of the name. Must equal the APP_SLUG derived in app-config.ts.

package_scope.description: npm scope for the workspace packages, i.e. <scope>/web and <scope>/shared.

purpose.description: One full sentence saying what the app is for. Used as prose, not as a label, so write it as a sentence.

tagline.description: One short hook for the README's first line. Kept separate from `purpose` so the generator never has to truncate a paragraph.

primary_entity.description: The thing this app is mostly about, in the three grammatical forms the docs need. `schema` must name a real key in docs/api/openapi.json components.schemas.

features.description: Drives the README and ARCHITECTURE feature lists, the documentation map, and the docs/app-workflows.md section skeleton.

route.description: The screen this feature lives on, or null for a feature with no screen of its own.

doc.description: Repo-relative path to the feature doc. Must exist: the doc-link check resolves it.

workflow_heading.description: Optional heading for this feature's section in docs/app-workflows.md, when the user journey is named differently from the feature. Defaults to `title`.

b2_surface.description: Which Backblaze B2 operations the app uses and why. The `why` is what makes the architecture doc readable instead of a bare verb list.

b2_key_prefix.description: Key prefix every object this app writes lives under. Also the value to use for ALLOWED_KEY_PREFIX when confining a shared bucket.

deployment_targets.description: Which delivery contracts this app ships. Decides which infra/<target>/README.md is referenced, and whether the README carries a one-click deploy button.

env_vars.description: Every variable the app reads. `secret` splits the infra variable tables; `required` decides whether the README and the deploy button ask for it.

attribution_token.description: The one B2 attribution token, shared by the S3 client's user_agent_extra and every utm_content. `pnpm gen:check` asserts it matches the value in services/api/app/repo/b2_client.py.

repo.description: Where this app lives, for the absolute GitHub URLs the README needs (clone command, deploy button, issue links).

screenshots.description: README screenshots. An EMPTY array is valid and meaningful: the generator then emits no image embeds, no "What it looks like" section and no demo-image parameter, so a fresh scaffold that has not taken its screenshots yet still passes the doc-link check.
